info.name: Tradeshift External Dx Category Assignments Update API

params.name: id
params.description: An UUID representing the assignment id.

items.docs: Updates an assignment with assignees, tags, comment, outcome. The new assignees will be added to the existing ones and the duplicates will be removed. The new tags will be added to the existing ones and the duplicates will be removed. The comment will replace the existing one. The outcome will replace the existing one.

items.docs:
Update the status of the assignment to CLOSED.
The assignment can be closed if it is in OPEN state.
